sources.title: BGE Small EN v1.5 by BGE — Embedding Model | Vincony
sources.snippet: BGE Small EN v1.5 is the smallest model in the BGE (BAAI General Embedding) series from the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI). Despite its compact size, it achieves competitive retrieval performance by leveraging the same training methodology — including instruction-tuned contrastive learning — used across the BGE family.

sources.title: BGE Small EN v1.5 Embedding Model - Rapid
sources.snippet: ## Overview BGE Small EN v1.5 is a compact and efficient text embedding model developed by the BAAI. It is designed to convert natural language text into dense vector representations that capture semantic meaning, enabling advanced search, retrieval, and similarity matching systems.
